task: Cover the appointment booking page (`/`). A visitor picks a day, books a free slot, and sees it under My bookings; the slot then shows as Yours for them and stays booked after a reload. Cancelling one of their bookings frees the slot again, so it can be booked once more. If another visitor took the slot in the meantime (the seam `POST /api/dev/take` simulates that), booking it shows `That slot was just taken` and the slot list refreshes to show it as Taken. The My bookings heading shows the number of bookings in parentheses.
